function escapeHtml(str): string;

Defined in: core/utils/string.ts:45

Escapes HTML-significant characters for safe insertion into innerHTML or double-quoted attributes. & must be replaced first so the entities emitted by the later replacements are not double-escaped. Pure ESM utility function, tree-shakeable.

Parameters

str

string

— raw text that may contain &, <, >, ", '

Returns

string

entity-escaped text safe for markup contexts
